text: The author employs an alternating first-person point of view, shifting between members of a space expedition team to provide multiple perspectives. The tone varies depending on the narrator: it is optimistic and curious when voiced by the scientist, and pragmatic and cautious when voiced by the engineer. Additionally, the language style adapts to the subject matter, using technical terminology for machinery and phenomena, while becoming more reflective and philosophical when the characters contemplate their existence in the universe.
